story_type: boat swamping far offshore, C-130 raft drop, good Samaritan pickup
hook: Their boat was going under, 46 miles from shore.
narration: Their boat was filling with water, forty six miles off the North Carolina coast.
Three people were aboard, southeast of Cape Fear.
A Coast Guard Hercules from Air Station Elizabeth City flew out and found them.
A Hercules can't pick anyone up. It circles overhead, guides help in, and drops gear to people in the water.
This crew dropped them a life raft, and it reached the boat.
[short pause] By then, the back of the boat was underwater.
The three moved into the bright orange raft, tied alongside.
Then a good Samaritan boat pulled up next to them.
outcome: The good Samaritan crew and the Coast Guard rescued all three mariners.

location_card.place: 46 miles southeast of Cape Fear, North Carolina

title: Boat going under 46 miles off Cape Fear
description:
On Nov. 27, 2020, a Coast Guard HC-130 Hercules crew from Air Station Elizabeth City dropped a life raft to three mariners whose boat was taking on water about 46 miles southeast of Cape Fear, North Carolina, and a good Samaritan boat picked them up.
